pairs.question: Can a taxpayer be treated as materially participating in a business because they materially participated in a related business for five of the last ten years?

pairs.question: Can a taxpayer be treated as materially participating in a business because they materially participated in a related business for five of the last ten years?

pairs.question: Can a taxpayer be treated as materially participating in a business because they materially participated in a related business for five of the last ten years?

pairs.question: What happens when a taxpayer with a full-time job claims real estate professional status but cannot show more time in real estate than in their other work?

pairs.question: When evaluating an offer in compromise from a cannabis business, can the IRS ignore expenses that section 280E makes nondeductible?

pairs.question: When evaluating an offer in compromise from a cannabis business, can the IRS ignore expenses that section 280E makes nondeductible?

pairs.question: Does a penalty approval form that only refers to the individual partners satisfy the written supervisory approval requirement for penalties against the partnership?

pairs.question: Has the Tax Court allowed a taxpayer to deduct the expenses of their bowling activities as a business?

pairs.question: Will the Tax Court allow a home office deduction for a converted in-law suite with its own entrance, and for a spare room the taxpayer says he used only for work?

pairs.question: Will the Tax Court allow a home office deduction for a converted in-law suite with its own entrance, and for a spare room the taxpayer says he used only for work?
